description: This file defines an internal class ConfigureDistributedGrainDirectory that implements the ISiloConfigurator interface. It provides configuration logic to add a distributed grain directory to an Orleans silo builder within the Orleans testing host environment.

classes.name: ConfigureDistributedGrainDirectory
classes.description: An internal class implementing ISiloConfigurator that configures the Orleans silo with a distributed grain directory.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the provided ISiloBuilder by adding a distributed grain directory.
